frame.objective: Determine if Moldex-Metric should expand its sales from workplaces to direct consumer markets, identifying potential consumer segments, value proposition, and key investigation areas before investing.
constraints: No company data on consumer sales or pricing
Test budget of 20,000 EUR and 12-week limit are analyst assumptions
alternatives: Target specific consumer segments (e.g., DIYers, hobbyists, remote workers)

searches: Direct-to-consumer hearing protection strategies, consumer segments for hearing protection, pricing models, consumer vs.

T1.claim: Moldex-Metric can successfully transition to direct-to-consumer sales by targeting specific segments with a value proposition emphasizing safety, convenience, and product quality.
T1.who_benefits: Moldex-Metric, consumers seeking hearing protection, and potential partners in the DTC channel.
T1.why_behaviour_changes: Consumers increasingly prioritize hearing protection for health and safety, and direct sales can reduce distribution costs.
T1.how_value_is_captured: Revenue from direct sales, increased brand awareness, and potential partnerships.
assumptions: Consumers are willing to pay a premium for hearing protection
Moldex-Metric can effectively market its products to new segments
Distribution costs can be offset by direct sales
predictions: Direct sales can increase revenue by 15-20% within 12 weeks
Target segments (e.g., DIYers, hobbyists) show higher willingness to pay

final.recommendation: Moldex-Metric should not pursue direct-to-consumer sales without further investigation. Instead, focus on optimizing workplace sales and exploring partnerships for DTC channels.
final.value_proposition: Safe, high-quality hearing protection at competitive prices through workplace distribution
final.next_action: Conduct consumer surveys to identify new segments and refine value proposition
final.uncertainty: Consumer willingness to pay for hearing protection is uncertain
would_change_if: New data shows high demand for hearing protection among specific segments
